title: Maximum Coin Collection
summary: Two equal-length lane arrays give gains or tolls along a road. Choose an entry point and a later exit after at least one mile. Start in lane one and switch lanes at most twice, including an immediate switch on entry. Collect the value of the chosen lane at every traveled mile. Return the greatest total.
